evals.prompt: Prepare a GitHub PR command from this simulated repository state, but do not push or call GitHub. Treat these values as verified command output: the current branch is `feature/cache-key`; its upstream is `origin/feature/cache-key`; remote `origin` is `git@github.com:acme/widget.git`; `gh repo view` identifies `acme/widget`, which is not a fork and whose default branch is `develop`; no PR matches this head; the user did not request a base and prefers draft PRs. Return the resolved target repository, push remote and repository, head ref, base, mode, and exact non-interactive `gh pr create` command with title/body placeholders.
evals.expected_output: A Create-mode plan targeting acme/widget from feature/cache-key, pushed through origin, based on develop, with a draft gh command. The branch upstream is used only as the push destination and never as the PR base.
expectations: The resolved base is `develop`, the target repository's default branch.
The output does not use `origin/feature/cache-key` or `feature/cache-key` as the PR base.
The resolved target repository is `acme/widget`, the push remote is `origin`, and the head ref is `feature/cache-key`.
The proposed command includes `--repo acme/widget`, `--base develop`, `--head feature/cache-key`, `--draft`, `--title`, and `--body-file`.
No push or GitHub mutation is executed.

evals.prompt: Prepare a GitHub PR command for an upstream contribution from this simulated repository state, but do not push or call GitHub. Treat these values as verified command output: branch `feature/a11y-labels` tracks `origin/feature/a11y-labels`; `origin` is `git@github.com:alice/widget.git`; checkout repo `alice/widget` is a fork whose parent is `acme/widget`; remote `upstream` is `git@github.com:acme/widget.git`; target repo `acme/widget` has default branch `develop`; Alice explicitly asked to contribute this branch to the parent; no exact PR matches owner `alice` plus branch `feature/a11y-labels`; Alice prefers draft PRs. Return checkout, target and push repositories/remotes, head owner/ref, base, mode, and the exact non-interactive create command.
evals.expected_output: A fork-aware Create-mode plan that pushes to Alice's origin, targets acme/widget through upstream, uses alice:feature/a11y-labels as the cross-repository head, and bases the PR on acme/widget's develop branch.
expectations: The target repository is `acme/widget` and its target remote is `upstream`.
The push repository is `alice/widget` and its push remote is `origin`.
The head owner is `alice` and the head ref is `alice:feature/a11y-labels`.
The resolved base is the target repository's `develop`, not the fork's default branch or `origin/feature/a11y-labels`.
The proposed command includes `--repo acme/widget --base develop --head alice:feature/a11y-labels --draft`.
PR discovery is described as matching both the branch name and `headRepositoryOwner.login`, not the branch name alone.
No push or GitHub mutation is executed.

evals.prompt: Audit, but do not edit, open PR https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42. Treat this fixture as verified: target and push repository are both `acme/widget`; head is `feature/export`; base is `main`; the exact owner+branch match is OPEN. Its current body says `Exports are hidden for every user` and `No download endpoint exists yet`. The current diff shows the export action is visible to users with `reports:download`, wires `GET /reports/{id}/download`, and adds authorization tests. Return the mode, every stale claim, and replacement wording grounded only in the fixture.
evals.expected_output: A Draft-only inspection of an existing open PR, with both obsolete body claims corrected in proposed wording. No mutation is authorized by the audit request.
expectations: The operation is read-only inspection/Draft-only even though the exact PR match is open.
The output identifies `Exports are hidden for every user` as stale and replaces it with the verified `reports:download` audience.
The output identifies `No download endpoint exists yet` as stale and accounts for `GET /reports/{id}/download`.
The proposed replacement mentions the authorization tests without inventing test results beyond the fixture.
The existing PR is not edited because the task requests an audit only.

evals.prompt: Classify two independent simulated PR snapshots without mutating GitHub. In both snapshots the target is `acme/widget`, the head owner is `acme`, the branch is `feature/search`, and there is no exact OPEN match. Snapshot A has exact historical PR https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/18 with state CLOSED. Snapshot B has exact historical PR https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/11 with state MERGED. In each snapshot, commits remain against the target default branch. Explain the mode or terminal state and the next user decision.
evals.expected_output: Neither historical PR is treated as Update. Each URL/state is reported, no edit or reopen occurs, and creating a new PR is presented as an explicit user decision because commits remain.
expectations: The CLOSED PR is identified as historical state and is not classified as Update.
The MERGED PR is identified as historical state and is not classified as Update.
The output does not propose `gh pr edit` against either historical PR.
The output does not reopen either PR or create a replacement without approval.
Both exact PR URLs and states are reported, together with the decision whether the remaining commits should become a new PR.
